title: Reserve Bank of India (Authentication Mechanisms for Digital Payment Transactions) Directions 2025
venue_or_ref: RBI/2025-26/79, issued 25 Sep 2025 under Sec 18 r/w Sec 10(2) PSS Act 2007
verification_note: Listed in RBI circular index (checked 2026-10-29). Effective date 1 Apr 2026 seen in secondary sources; confirm against the circular PDF before citing the date.
relevance: Two-factor floor for all digital payments; permits risk-based additional checks. Our engine only adds checks above this floor (tier 0 = PIN, never less).
